newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait appoints new oil, defence ministers.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait appoints new oil, defence ministers.

text.p: Kuwait announced a new cabinet on Tuesday, giving the oil, defence and interior portfolios to new ministers, the official Kuwait News Agency (KUNA) reported.
It said Foreign Minister Sheikh Sabah al-Ahmad al-Sabah kept his post. Issa al-Mazeedi was appointed oil minister, KUNA said.
Kuwait's Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah reappointed Crown Prince Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah as prime minister following parliamentary elections last week.
Nasser Abdulla al-Rodhan kept his post as Finance Minister and is one of three deputy prime ministers.

Sheikh Salem Sabah al-Salem al-Sabah, a former foreign minister, was given the Defence Ministry and is also a deputy prime minister. The Ministry of Interior was given to Sheikh Mohammad Khaled al-Hamad al-Sabah, also a member of the ruling family, KUNA said.
The new U.S.-educated Oil Minister Mazeedi will be in charge of the state's main revenue earner. OPEC-member Kuwait currently produces about two million barrels a day.
